INSERT INTO lazy_loaded_members (
                user_id,
                device_id,
                room_id,
                member_user_id,
                created_ts,
                updated_ts
            )
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, member_user_id, $4, $4
            FROM UNNEST($5::TEXT[]) AS member_user_id
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, device_id, room_id, member_user_id)
            DO UPDATE SET updated_ts = EXCLUDED.updated_ts
